issues.title: Attendance today returns NO_EMPLOYEE_RECORD for SUPER_ADMIN
issues.where: Attendance / /attendance (also Dashboard widgets that call today)
issues.why: GET /api/attendance/today → 400 NO_EMPLOYEE_RECORD because superadmin@acme.test has no linked Employee. UI still triggers employee-scoped endpoint.
issues.how: BE: return 200 empty payload for admin roles without employeeId (or dedicated admin today endpoint). FE: skip /attendance/today when user.employeeId is null; show org/team attendance only.

issues.title: Performance page duplicate React keys
issues.why: 40× console: Encountered two children with the same key (employee IDs reused as keys).
issues.how: Use unique keys (e.g. `${employeeId}-${cycleId}` or index+id) in Performance list/map renders.
issues.actual: Repeated React key warnings on Performance

issues.title: Reports Export CSV download did not complete
issues.why: Playwright download event for workforce-headcount-report.csv fired but file path/failure indicated unsuccessful save (ok:false).
issues.how: Verify FE blob download + Content-Disposition handling for reports CSV; ensure click triggers real download not cancelled navigation.

issues.title: Assets Export CSV download did not complete
issues.how: Fix Assets export download handler (blob URL / anchor download).

issues.title: Login page fires auth/me and refresh 401 before credentials
issues.how: Skip /auth/me and /auth/refresh on public auth routes; suppress expected 401 noise.
